name: Military Guard Aiden
source:
Completely lost in the middle of nowhere, your car breaks down and forces you to continue on foot. But then.. A little piece of civilization appears on the horizon.
Apparently, you’ve stumbled upon an old military base. And now it’s up to you to convince military guard Aiden to let you have a little rest before you have to carry on.

Or will you be able to get some more help from him?

[From the [url=https://oonyxgames.com/game/military-guard-aiden/]official website[/url]]
translation:
你完全迷失在一个偏僻的地方，你的车抛锚了，迫使你继续步行。但随后……一小部分文明出现在地平线上。
显然，你偶然发现了一个古老的军事基地。现在你需要说服军事警卫艾登让你休息一下，然后再继续前进。

或者你能从他那里得到更多帮助吗？

[摘自[url=https://oonyxgames.com/game/military-guard-aiden/]官网[/url]]
